# Libib

> Libib is a cloud-based library management system that enables users to catalog, organize, and sync personal media collections across devices using barcode scanning and multi-device synchronization.

Libib provides a comprehensive solution for managing home and institutional libraries with support for ISBN/UPC scanning, mobile apps on iOS and Android, and educational pricing tiers. The platform includes enterprise features like SSO authentication and multi-user management for schools and organizations.

## Key Topics

- Cloud Cataloging
